name: agent-runbook-lint-skill
description: Local-first lint checks for agent automation runbooks.

scripts.check: "$(bash scripts/python-for-npm.sh)" -B -c "import ast, pathlib; [ast.parse(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8'), filename=str(p)) for root in ('src', 'tests') for p in pathlib.Path(root).rglob('*.py')]"
scripts.release:check: npm run check && npm test && npm run smoke
